affiliate: This site is not affiliated with Ubiquiti in any way.
name: Name
module-read: Module EEPROM was read successfully, saving Data now.
module-saved: Module EEPROM was saved successfully from Wizard.
module-error: Unable to read Module, please unplug and plug it back in.

reboot-success: Device will be rebooted in a few seconds...
name-message: Enter a new name for the device.

name-unchanged: Device name unchanged because it is identical to the current name.
no-eeprom-selected: No EEPROM Dump to flash was selected.

eeprom-file-error: Incorrect EEPROM Dump file format, File should be 512 (SFP) or 640 (QSFP) Bytes long.
eeprom-sync-nomodule: To transmit an EEPROM Dump, an fibre module must be connected to the device.
sif-error-start: Unable to request the serial interface, please try again.
sif-error: Unable to read the serial interface.
sif-start: Log file was created and will be downloaded now from the Wizard.
module-meta-description: Click on Read SFP to read the Metadata from the Module.
backup-required-message: No local backup found for this module's serial number. Please click "Save" first to back it up before writing.
backup-saved-message: Module EEPROM backed up locally on this device.
backup-read-error: Unable to verify a backup exists - please read the module again before writing.
profiles-loaded: Loaded the profiles stored on the Wizard.
profiles-empty: The Wizard's Profile Store is empty.
profiles-load-failed: Failed to load the Wizard's Profile Store (requires firmware 1.1.8 or newer).
profiles-read-failed: Failed to read the stored profile.
profiles-placeholder: No profiles loaded - click "Load Profiles" first
profiles-upload-message: Add the selected EEPROM profile to the Wizard's internal Profile Store? The app re-uploads the profiles already stored on the device together with the new one (the BLE upload replaces the whole store).
profiles-uploaded: Profile uploaded - the Wizard's Profile Store now holds {{n}} profiles.
profiles-upload-failed: Failed to upload the profile to the Wizard (requires firmware 1.1.8 or newer).
profiles-upload-invalid: Invalid EEPROM dump - only SFP (512 byte) and QSFP (640 byte) snapshots can be uploaded.
profiles-repo-none-selected: Select at least one profile from the repository list.
